blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `updateCartPromotionsStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.
This step updates the promotions applied on a cart.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the cart to update promotions for.

children.name: promo_codes
children.description: The promotion codes to apply on the cart.

children.name: action
children.description: Whether to add, remove, or replace promotion codes.
